text: First local implementation of D10. The release inspector selects a built-in file viewer by format. CSV/TSV, exact JSON and UTF-8 text, and on-demand PNG/JPEG share an authorized byte reader and bounded rendering. Chromium and PostgreSQL passed 13 scenarios, including the published Matching Pennies stimulus and denied preview for a metadata-only grant. The browser and persistence receipt is target/console-backend.EFE96Z/receipt.json. Keep D10 open. Next acceptance: an authorized questionnaire table shows the column descriptions, levels and units associated with the same release. A bounded NIfTI slice viewer must display a known anatomical slice with correct orientation under the production content security policy, explain unsupported/oversized inputs, and require the same content grant.
